title: AI Makes Death Optional? Brockman Poses the Ultimate Question of Life

content_html: At a recent Wall Street Journal Tech Summit, OpenAI President Greg Brockman made a claim radical enough to upend conventional wisdom: in the future, death may become something people can choose for themselves. He did not make an absolute claim, but stressed that breakthroughs in biology "are not just about humans," and that whether death can become an option "is itself a question worth considering." He also noted that people endure all kinds of suffering, and that all of this could come true.
